Completed the Widget Forge check-in against the October 19 baseline in GitHub-backed Mode A. I used the supplied snapshot for `example-fixtures/widget-forge`.

- **Progress.** PRs #21, #22, and #23 were merged. Issues #11, #12, and #13 were closed, so their matching Compass tasks moved to done. Milestone #7 rose from 0% to 60% (3 of 5 issues closed). The dimensional-checks objective remains in progress.
- **Scope drift.** PR #23 added `src/render.py` even though the README and charter exclude rendering. I logged the contradiction and left the scope decision open. Rendering remains outside the declared scope. The project’s vision, mission, and success criteria are still undocumented.
- **Local records.** I saved the [delta report](.compass/reports/delta-run-20261124-widget-forge.md), updated the tracker and pointer mirror, and saved a fresh baseline, run receipt, and history entry. No GitHub changes were made.

**Validation passed at 98/100 (band A).** The snapshot lacked event dates and the metadata required to verify a complete GitHub pull. The prior baseline lacked file checksums, so file-level changes since October 19 could not be independently verified.

# Widget Forge check-in, 2026-11-24

Run run-20261124-widget-forge - reassess - since 2026-10-19

Mode A (GitHub-backed, github-origin, high confidence). The origin in `.git/config` matches the saved Mode A identity and configured project `example-fixtures/widget-forge`. The fixture has a symbolic HEAD, and usable Git history and live `gh` authentication were unavailable. Hosted evidence comes from the supplied snapshot. Its merge dates, closure dates, release data and full issue inventory are unavailable. The prior baseline is dated 2026-10-19 and has no file checksums. The current observation date is 2026-11-24.

Compass validation scored 98/100, band A, gate PASS. All eleven checks ran. V11 warned that the offline pointer mirror requires a complete, identity-checked pull before planning.

## Executive summary

- Three tracked tasks moved from in progress to done. Issues #11, #12 and #13 are closed and match the saved Compass identifiers.
- GitHub milestone #7 is 60% complete (3 of 5 issues closed, 2 open), up from the prior mirror’s 0%. The objective remains in progress.
- Three PRs are marked merged in the supplied snapshot. PR #21 reads units, PR #22 checks dimensions, and PR #23 adds a rendering module.
- PR #23 and `src/render.py` conflict with the declared rendering non-goal in `README.md` and `docs/CHARTER.md`. An owner decision is open.
- Milestone #8 has no Compass marker. The snapshot shows zero unmarked issues and lists three issue records. Milestone #7 reports two open issues whose records were outside the supplied snapshot.

## Intent and inventory

The README declares the purpose and goal of checking dimensions in widget packs. It and the charter declare rendering out of scope. The vision, mission and success criteria are unknown. The saved Compass inventory has one objective and three linked tasks. The prior state counts one run, and its report, receipt and history row are unavailable.

## Moved

| ID | Task | From | To | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TSK-799E1F5F | Read dimensions | in progress | done | Issue #11 closed, exact Compass marker |
| TSK-DE24D33A | Validate units | in progress | done | Issue #12 closed, exact Compass marker |
| TSK-E6015390 | Check tolerances | in progress | done | Issue #13 closed, exact Compass marker |

Closure dates and reasons are absent from the snapshot. The task updates use the observed closure disposition. The prior mirror had all three issues open. No individual PR-to-task mapping was established.

## Stalled and at risk

The prior objective evidence date was 2026-10-19, 36 days before this run, below the 60-day staleness threshold and the 180-day abandonment threshold. The current milestone snapshot provides a fresh progress signal. README and charter file dates are 2026-11-22, 2 days old against the 120-day document threshold. Scope is the main risk. Coverage change is unknown because there are no comparable measurements, and release movement is unknown because the snapshot supplies no release data.

## New and orphaned work

PR #23 merged a widget preview renderer with no adopted objective. The proposal to make rendering an explicit goal is an open question. The missing prior file checksums prevent an independent added/changed/removed file comparison. This run captures a new manifest for future comparisons.

## Drift

| ID | Kind | Evidence | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DRF-43152320 | contradiction | PR #23 merged, `src/render.py` present, rendering excluded by the README and charter | open |

## Hosted and local tracking divergence

`DRF-08FC0C42` records issues #11, #12 and #13 closed in the snapshot while their saved tasks were in progress. Local statuses were reconciled. The hosted snapshot lacks repository and completeness metadata required by the pull helper. The local pointer index was refreshed from marker-matched snapshot rows and marked incomplete for planning. GitHub writes and scheduler registrations were zero.

## Unchanged

One objective remains in progress. The declared purpose, goal and rendering non-goal still apply.

## Open questions

- `QST-BC16A238` Should rendering become an explicit project goal? Rendering remains outside the declared scope pending an owner decision.
